summary: Iteration 5 frontend validation for Nekhwa: RTL layout flip on web (direction:'rtl'), expanded Arabic/Farsi/Urdu translations, and new Home Delivery option on Find Food screen all verified end-to-end via mobile-viewport Playwright on the public preview URL. All 7 acceptance criteria pass.

issues: Horizontal filter chip ScrollView is slightly clipped on the leading edge in RTL — the first chip 'الكل' visually overlaps with the section heading 'مطاعم ومتبرعون قريبون'. Functionally OK (chip is tappable), but a small contentInset / paddingStart fix would tidy the look. Minor / cosmetic.
Date strings (Today/Yesterday/Last week/3 days ago) remain hard-coded English — out of scope for iter 5 but worth queueing for iter 6.

validation_results.1_rtl_flip: PASS — root View applies direction:'rtl' on web; header back arrow flips to right, content right-aligned, bottom tabs reorder, list cards mirror correctly.
validation_results.2_profile_translations_ar: PASS — Profile screen shows البطاقة القطرية (Qatar ID), الهاتف (Phone), التفضيلات (Preferences), التحقق (Verification), موثق (Verified), تغيير الدور (Switch Role).
validation_results.3_activity_translations_ar: PASS — Recipient activity shows 'عائلة من 4', 'الوكرة', 'تم الربط', 'تم تنفيذه', '✓ تم الربط مع راف قطر'. Donor activity status pills render 'تم' (delivered) and 'في الطريق' (in transit) — no DELIVERED/IN TRANSIT/OPEN English leak. 'وجبة' used for meals.
validation_results.4_find_food_4_chips: PASS — testIDs filter-all, filter-pickup, filter-byo, filter-delivery all present. Labels in AR: الكل / استلام ذاتي / أحضر إناءك / توصيل للمنزل.
validation_results.5_r3_no_delivery: PASS — restaurant-r3 (Pearl Cafe) exposes pickup-r3 and byo-r3 only (delivery-r3 is absent in DOM).
validation_results.6_filter_delivery_filters: PASS — selecting filter-delivery shows exactly restaurant-r1, restaurant-r2, restaurant-r4, restaurant-r5 (4 of 5).
validation_results.7_leaderboard_you_label: PASS — Arabic shows 'Ahmed Al-Mahmoud (أنت)'; English shows 'You'. Direct verification of i18n key 'you'.
validation_results.delivery_alert: PASS — tapping delivery-r1 (warning/orange button) triggers confirmation alert with Arabic restaurant name and 'توصيل للمنزل' label.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: in find-food.tsx filterRow, add paddingStart equal to SPACING.lg or wrap with extra padding so first chip in RTL doesn't visually collide with the section heading.
Iter 6 candidate: translate relative date strings ('Today', 'Yesterday', 'Last week', '3 days ago', '2h', '5h', '1d') in mockData / activity / recent feed.
Persist selected language via AsyncStorage so a hard refresh / direct-URL navigation keeps the chosen locale (currently in-memory only via AppContext).
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx applies direction:'rtl' on the root View — works on web (where View becomes a div and CSS direction takes effect) but on native iOS/Android this approach has no effect; for production native parity, use I18nManager.forceRTL with an app reload. Not blocking for current web-preview scope.
find-food.tsx filterRow uses fixed flexDirection:'row' inside horizontal ScrollView — leading-edge clipping in RTL is minor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Language state lives only in React context (AppContext); reload or page.goto resets to English. Always switch language via in-app language sheet before navigating, or persist via AsyncStorage if added later. Recipient flow exposes tabs: home, activity (طلباتي), profile. Donor flow exposes: home, activity (تبرعاتي), profile. Find Food screen testIDs: find-food-screen, filter-{all|pickup|byo|delivery}, restaurant-{r1..r5}, pickup-{rid}, byo-{rid}, delivery-{rid}. r3 has no delivery button by design.
